Capco

Capco is a leading global technology and management consultancy that excels in driving digital transformation within the financial services and insurance sectors. With an unwavering commitment to delivering practical solutions, we empower our clients to navigate the complexities of today's fast-paced market. Our integrated services span across major financial hubs worldwide, ensuring that we are always close to our clients and their needs.

At Capco, we possess not only the expertise but also the vision and passion necessary to lead transformative change. As we embark on an exciting growth journey, this is the perfect moment to join our team. We are expanding geographically, increasing our workforce, and poised to disrupt the consulting landscape across APAC with our entrepreneurial spirit and agile methodologies.

About the Role

We are thrilled to introduce an opportunity for a talented AI Engineer to join our Singapore team. This role is designed for a technology innovator who thrives on solving complex challenges and is passionate about building AI-driven solutions that transform the Financial Services industry. As an AI Engineer at Capco, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the future of insurance by leveraging cutting-edge AI technologies to deliver intelligent, scalable, and compliant solutions. Your work will enable our clients to unlock new efficiencies, enhance customer experience, and stay ahead in a rapidly evolving digital landscape. If you are excited about applying advanced AI techniques to real-world business problems and driving measurable impact, we want you on our team.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build multi-agent workflows to optimize business processes within insurance.
  • Develop and maintain software pipelines for data processing, model training, and deployment using Python-based frameworks.
  • Train, fine-tune, and optimize neural network models, including LLMs, for specific use cases such as risk assessment and customer query resolution.
  • Collaborate with data scientists, engineers, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into production-ready AI applications.
  • Ensure AI models adhere to banking regulations, data privacy standards (e.g., GDPR, CCPA), and ethical AI practices.
  • Monitor deployed solutions in production, troubleshooting issues, and implement updates as needed.
  • Strong experience delivering production-grade applications, backend services and technical components that support data, workflow, automation or AI-driven solutions.
  • Participate in code reviews, agile ceremonies, and CI/CD processes.

Experience and Qualifications

  • 3–12 years of professional experience in AI/ML engineering, with a focus on software development and deployment.
  • Build and integrate components for LLM, RAG, search, agent-based and automation solutions,
  • Strong software engineering experience with Python, Java, React Next, Node.js
  • Hands-on experience training and fine-tuning neural network models, with a track record of optimizing for performance and scalability.
  • Proven expertise working with LLMs (e.g., GPT, BERT) and building agentic solutions using frameworks like LangChain, LangGraph, or ADK.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud) for model deployment and data management.
  • Solid understanding of machine learning concepts, including supervised/unsupervised learning, evaluation metrics, and bias mitigation.
  • Experience with version control systems (e.g., Git) and agile methodologies.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to work in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in financial services domains
  • Familiarity with big data tools (e.g., Spark, Hadoop) and databases (SQL/NoSQL).
  • Knowledge of graph databases and knowledge graphs.
  • Understanding DevOps practices, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and MLOps workflows.
  • Publications, open-source contributions, or certifications in AI/ML.
  • Strong communication skills for presenting technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

ELIGIBILITY TO WORK IN SG

Applicants must have unrestricted working rights in Singapore. Only Singapore Citizens and Singapore Permanent Residents (PRs) will be considered. Employment Pass sponsorship is not available for this role.

jobs.description_text:
ABOUT CAPCO

Capco, a Wipro company, is a global management and technology consultancy specialising in driving digital transformation across the financial services industry. Operating at the intersection of business and technology, Capco combines innovative thinking with unrivalled industry knowledge to fast-track initiatives for banking and payments, capital markets, wealth and asset management, and insurance. Our ingenuity is brought to life through our Innovation Labs, award-winning Be Yourself at Work culture, and a diverse, talented team across more than 30 offices worldwide.

ROLE DESCRIPTION

Every consequential moment in financial services — approving a policy, extending credit, flagging a transaction, recommending a portfolio — is a decision. The best financial institutions do not leave those decisions to chance, intuition, or inconsistent human judgement. They engineer them: combining predictive analytics, business rules, and optimisation into decision services that are fast, consistent, auditable, and continuously improving. That discipline is Enterprise Decision Management.

As an AI Specialist in Enterprise Decision Management, you will lead the design and delivery of intelligent decision automation solutions for Capco's financial services clients across Asia. You will help clients move beyond point-in-time analytics and disconnected AI engines toward closed-loop decision systems: where predictive models inform rules, rules govern actions, outcomes are measured, and both models and rules are continuously refined as a result.

This role demands genuine depth across the full AI and decision management spectrum — from classical techniques such as expert systems, case-based reasoning, and scorecards, through to modern machine learning, optimisation, and large language model integration. We are not looking for generalists who discovered AI in the last few years. We are looking for practitioners who have spent a career building, deploying, and improving intelligent decision systems in production financial services environments.

Think of this as a forward-deployed role: you will be embedded with clients, building working solutions alongside their teams, and leaving behind capabilities that outlast the engagement. You will also play a defining role in building Capco's Enterprise Decision Management practice across Asia.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Decision Strategy & Architecture

  • Lead the design of end-to-end Enterprise Decision Management (EDM) architectures — connecting data ingestion, predictive model scoring, business rule execution, decision optimisation, and outcome measurement into coherent, production-grade decision services.
  • Advise clients on decision strategy: identifying which decisions to automate, which to augment, and which to keep in human hands — and designing the governance frameworks to manage each appropriately.
  • Model and decompose complex financial services decision domains — underwriting, claims adjudication, credit and affordability assessment, client suitability, fraud detection, and regulatory compliance — into structured decision architectures using DMN and related standards.
  • Define the feedback loops and monitoring frameworks that allow decision systems to learn from outcomes — closing the loop between prediction, decision, action, and measurement.

Predictive Analytics & Optimisation

  • Design and oversee the development of predictive models — including scorecards, logistic regression, gradient boosting, and neural network approaches — that feed directly into operational decision flows.
  • Apply prescriptive analytics and mathematical optimisation techniques (linear programming, constraint optimisation, genetic algorithms) to maximise decision outcomes at portfolio or population level, not just at the individual transaction level.
  • Advise on champion/challenger frameworks, model validation approaches, and the governance of model changes within live decision systems — ensuring clients meet MAS, HKMA, and internal model risk management requirements.
  • Apply classical AI techniques — expert systems, case-based reasoning, Bayesian inference — where they are the most appropriate and explainable tool for a given decision problem.

Rules Engineering & Decision Automation

  • Distinguish clearly between rule engine integration concerns (deployment architecture, service exposure, API design, DevOps pipelines for rules) and rule service design concerns (authoring, testing, governance, and versioning of business logic) — and bring demonstrated expertise in both.
  • Design the interfaces between predictive model outputs and rules engine inputs — ensuring that model scores, segments, and recommendations are consumed correctly within decision flows and that the combined output is auditable.

Modern AI Integration

  • Integrate decision management capabilities with LLM and generative AI architectures — including patterns such as rules-based guardrails over LLM outputs, LLM-driven document understanding feeding structured rule evaluation, and conversational interfaces over decision services.
  • Advise clients on where deterministic, rules-based approaches and probabilistic, model-based approaches are best combined — and design hybrid architectures that preserve the auditability and consistency that regulated financial services require.

Practice & Client Development

  • Drive business development activities including proposals, RFP responses, client workshops, and thought leadership on decision intelligence and AI in financial services.
  • Mentor junior and mid-level team members and contribute actively to building Capco's decision intelligence practice, intellectual property, and accelerators across Asia

KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES

  • Deliver robust, production-ready decision management solutions that demonstrably improve client decision quality, speed, consistency, and measurability.
  • Ensure decision systems meet the governance, auditability, explainability, and model risk requirements of financial services regulators across Asia-Pacific, including MAS and HKMA guidelines on the use of AI in decision-making.
  • Maintain and grow senior client relationships, acting as a trusted long-term advisor on decision intelligence strategy and roadmap.
  • Uphold Capco's standards of quality, integrity, and professionalism across all client engagements.
  • Contribute measurably to Capco Asia's decision management practice through reusable assets, methodology development, and external thought leadership.

THE PREFERRED CANDIDATE WILL

  • Have spent a decade or more building, deploying, and evolving intelligent decision systems in financial services — with a track record that spans the full EDM lifecycle from predictive model development through to rules-driven operational execution and outcome measurement.
  • Understand the complete toolbox of AI techniques available for decision problems — classical and modern — and have the experience and intellectual honesty to choose the right tool rather than default to whichever approach is currently receiving the most attention.
  • Be as fluent discussing scorecard development, Gini coefficients, and population stability indices as they are discussing transformer architectures, prompt engineering, and RAG pipelines.
  • Have deep domain expertise in insurance and/or wealth management decision logic, with secondary familiarity in banking or capital markets.
  • Be comfortable operating as a senior individual contributor, a client-facing advisor, and a practice builder — often simultaneously.
  • Thrive in Capco's flat, non-hierarchical culture and bring an entrepreneurial spirit to the challenge of building a high-value, differentiated capability in Asia.

MANDATORY SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

Business & Domain

  • Minimum 10 years of experience in decision management, AI engineering, or a closely related analytical discipline within financial services.
  • Proven track record of delivering Enterprise Decision Management solutions in production environments — combining predictive analytics, optimisation, and business rules within operational decision flows.
  • Strong domain knowledge in insurance and/or wealth management: underwriting decision logic, claims assessment, policy eligibility, suitability frameworks, KYC/AML rules, or client segmentation and next-best-action engines.
  • Experience advising senior stakeholders — Chief Analytics Officers, Chief Risk Officers, Chief Data Officers — on decision automation strategy and the business case for intelligent decisioning investments.

Technical — Decision Management & Classical AI

  • Hands-on experience with enterprise BRMS platforms in production: IBM Operational Decision Manager (ODM), FICO Blaze Advisor, Red Hat Decision Manager (RHDM), or IBM Drools — with the ability to distinguish and lead on both rule engine integration and rule service design.
  • Proficiency in decision modelling standards: DMN (Decision Model and Notation), PMML (Predictive Model Markup Language), and their use in documenting, governing, and exchanging decision and model assets.
  • Practical experience designing and implementing expert systems, including forward and backward chaining inference, Rete algorithm optimisation, and rule conflict resolution strategies.
  • Working knowledge of case-based reasoning (CBR), Bayesian networks, constraint satisfaction, and genetic and evolutionary algorithms — with experience applying these techniques to real financial services problems.
  • Experience designing and building traditional credit or insurance scorecards, including feature engineering, binning, weight-of-evidence encoding, logistic regression, and scorecard scaling.
  • Proficiency in decision optimisation: linear and integer programming, constraint-based optimisation, and the application of optimisation to portfolio-level decision problems such as collections strategy, offer optimisation, or risk-based pricing.

Technical — Predictive Modelling & Modern AI

  • Working knowledge of machine learning model development, validation, and deployment lifecycle — including gradient boosting (XGBoost, LightGBM), ensemble methods, and neural networks.
  • Experience designing champion/challenger frameworks, model monitoring pipelines, and population stability analysis for models operating within live decision systems.
  • Working knowledge of LLM capabilities and limitations, with practical experience designing hybrid decision architectures that combine deterministic rule engines with generative AI components.
  • Familiarity with AI explainability techniques (SHAP, LIME, counterfactual explanations) and their application in regulated financial services decision contexts.
  • Experience with model risk management frameworks and the documentation requirements of MAS FEAT principles, HKMA guidance on AI, or equivalent regulatory standards.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

  • Experience with real-time and event-driven decision architectures, including complex event processing (CEP), streaming decision services, and sub-second decisioning requirements.
  • Exposure to insurance platform ecosystems (Guidewire, Duck Creek, Majesco) or wealth platform ecosystems (Avaloq, FNZ, iCapital) and their integration

jobs.description_text: ABOUT THE ROLE Join a small engineering team at an early-stage AI infrastructure company focused on reinforcement learning and AI evaluation. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Diagnose ambiguous technical problems and clarify what needs to be done. - Own technical deployment requests from triage through completion for external partners and internal teams. - Build tools and one-off pipelines to solve urgent customer and partner problems. - Coordinate with research and go-to-market teams to unblock deployments. - Balance speed and quality when requirements are unclear and turnaround is urgent. - Document recurring issues and convert manual work into reusable tools and processes. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - Two to four years of experience in applied research engineering, forward-deployed engineering, or a similar hands-on technical role. - A technical educational background and strong generalist AI engineering skills. - Proficiency in Python, Docker, and Linux environments. - Experience with benchmarks and evaluations for AI agents and reinforcement learning training data, including sound judgment about task realism, rubric reliability, and useful trajectories. - Research engineering experience alongside deployment work, with a record of owning technical requests from triage to completion. - Strong debugging skills across code, data, and environments, plus experience building tools or pipelines for urgent problems. - Comfort working directly with technical customers, vendors, and cross-functional teams, including during production or deployment issues. - Ability to work independently amid ambiguity, exercise good judgment around speed, correctness, and security, and communicate effectively across time zones. - Experience in an early-stage startup and a habit of producing careful, original technical work. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Build pipelines that transform domain-specific workflows into realistic, structured synthetic training tasks. - Work with subject-matter experts to create tasks for AI agents across professional and technical domains. - Design generation methods that produce diverse, realistic, and learnable tasks. - Develop tools to mutate, validate, and improve synthetic tasks. - Analyze model and agent performance to understand task strengths, limitations, and failure modes. - Create metrics for task diversity, realism, learnability, and overall quality. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - Two or more years of relevant experience in software engineering, machine learning engineering, or AI research, with a technical background. - Hands-on experience applying synthetic data methods and delivering end-to-end data generation pipelines for AI or machine learning applications. - Proficiency in Python and experience working in Linux environments with containerization tools such as Docker. - Experience with synthetic data quality criteria, evaluation metrics, and the limitations of synthetic data. - Background building or maintaining evaluation frameworks, benchmarks, or testing environments for AI agents or large language models. - Experience automating the generation, validation, mutation, or processing of structured datasets at scale. - Ability to independently deliver technical projects in loosely defined problem spaces, with care for edge cases and data quality. - Familiarity with reinforcement learning, agent workflows, or LLM post-training is useful. jobs.title: Research Engineer, Synthetic Data

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - Two to four years of experience in research engineering, machine learning engineering, or a related technical role, including at least two years building or delivering AI benchmarks, evaluation infrastructure, or agent environments. - Strong proficiency in Python, Docker, and Linux for research or production infrastructure. - Hands-on experience designing, implementing, and operating evaluations for AI agents or large language models. - Experience building infrastructure to run models or agents reliably, and developing metrics, statistical analyses, or validation studies. - Ability to collaborate with subject-matter experts and analyze workflows across different domains to create useful evaluation tasks. - Strong technical writing, attention to detail, first-principles reasoning, and comfort working independently in a fast-paced startup. - Published research or technical writing on benchmarking, model evaluation, or failure modes is valued. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - Two to four years of experience as a research engineer or in a similar engineering or research role focused on quality control automation. - Technical education or equivalent technical experience, with proficiency in Python, Docker, and Linux. - Experience building scalable data validation pipelines and end-to-end automated QA/QC systems with autonomy in unstructured problem spaces. - Background in benchmarks and evaluations for reinforcement learning training data, including defining realistic tasks, reliable rubrics, and useful trajectories. - Experience defining and measuring training data quality, and designing evaluation metrics, experiments, and QA/QC processes. - Knowledge of statistics, strong communication skills, curiosity across domains, and the ability to collaborate independently across time zones. COMPENSATION & BENEFITS Base salary: $100,000 to $170,000 USD annually. Visa sponsorship is available. LOCATION On-site in Singapore, Singapore.

jobs.description_text: ABOUT US: Fireworks is the platform for specialized intelligence, enabling companies to build, train, and serve AI models tailored to their own data, workflows, and products. Founded by the team behind PyTorch and backed by AMD, Atreides, Benchmark Capital, Index Ventures, Lightspeed, NVIDIA, Sequoia Capital, and TCV, Fireworks powers production AI with hundreds of state-of-the-art open models across text, image, embedding, audio, and multimodal workloads. Today, Fireworks is a Series D company valued at $17.5 billion, bringing together an ambitious, collaborative team that's building the future of enterprise AI. In the last few months alone we launched Fireworks Training, partnered with Microsoft Azure Foundry, and published research straight from our production systems. A few examples of what that looks like in practice: - Frontier RL is cheaper than the mega-cluster narrative suggests: we ran cross-region rollouts using 98% sparse weight deltas and published what we learned. (blog https://fireworks.ai/blog/frontier-rl-is-cheaper-than-you-think) - Open source agents with frontier advisors: matching frontier performance through training and harness engineering. (blog https://fireworks.ai/blog/open-source-agents-frontier-advisors) - The fine-tuning bottleneck is not the algorithm: integration friction and iteration speed are what actually stall teams; we documented the patterns across dozens of customer engagements. (blog) https://fireworks.ai/blog/fine-tuning-bottlenecks The Role AI Field Engineers at Fireworks are the technical tip of the spear. You embed with our most ambitious customers and technology partners to turn complex AI problems into production systems, fast. The role sits at the intersection of engineering, product, and customer delivery. You are hands-on-keyboard building POCs, MVPs, and production integrations, while also holding your own in executive-level conversations about architecture, strategy, and business outcomes. You spend most of your time building. You ship code, run benchmarks, debug production issues, and architect deployments. But you also lead discovery conversations, align stakeholders, and translate customer pain points into product improvements that compress the feedback loop from field to roadmap. This is a role for engineers who are comfortable on-site with customers, building the relationships and trust that happen in person, not just over a call. The Segment As a Field Engineer in the Enterprise track you will work with large organizations and digital-native companies adopting GenAI across the business. These engagements span more stakeholders and longer cycles, so you will manage executive relationships and align teams while staying hands-on in the code. The emphasis is on pairing strong technical delivery with the executive presence to earn trust across an org: discovery, solution design, POC execution, and the path to production at enterprise scale. What You'll Work On Technical Delivery and Deployment - Build end-to-end POCs and MVPs alongside customer engineering teams, working inside their codebases, infrastructure, and constraints. - For customers whose core product is built on GenAI, architect the inference foundations that capability depends on, and size deployments so they can scale in their market without infrastructure becoming the bottleneck. - Run load tests and establish latency, throughput, and cost baselines against realistic customer traffic profiles, and tune deployments to hit those targets - Deploy and validate new model families on inference frameworks (vLLM, SGLang), determining optimal shapes, quantization configs, and serving patterns across workloads. Model Strategy and Fine-Tuning - Guide customers on model selection, fine-tuning strategy (SFT, DPO, RFT), and evaluation methodology. - Build and run fine-tuning pipelines directly with customers, navigating trade-offs between model families, compute cost, and quality targets. - Design and implement evaluation frameworks that measure production-quality metrics, not just benchmark scores. Customer Engagement and Stakeholder Management - Many of our customers exist because of GenAI. Help them bake frontier model capabilities into their core offering and turn that into a durable competitive edge. - Lead structured discovery conversations to unpack customer pain points, constraints, and success criteria before proposing solutions. - Own the technical relationship from first engagement through production deployment. Earn trust with ML engineers and VPs in the same meeting. - Spend time on-site with customers. Build trust and momentum in person, embedding with their teams where the work happens. Product Feedback and Platform Improvement - Identify recurring customer pain points and translate them into concrete product proposals, working directly with engineering and product to ship fixes and features. - Codify repeatable deployment patterns and contribute them back to internal tooling, documentation, and the platform itself. - Feed customer signals (deployment patterns, failure modes, feature gaps) back into the product roadmap with specificity and urgency. What We're Looking For Minimum Qualifications - 5+ years in a hands-on, customer-facing technical role: Forward Deployed Engineer, Applied AI Engineer, Solutions Architect, ML Engineer with field exposure, or technical founder. - Demonstrated ability to build production software with customers, not just advise on it. You have shipped code running in someone else's production environment. - Strong Python skills. Comfortable reading, writing, and debugging production code. Familiarity with Kubernetes and infrastructure engineering. - Working knowledge of the LLM stack: inference trade-offs, model serving, fine-tuning workflows (SFT at minimum; DPO/RFT a strong plus). - Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, GCP) and deploying models on GPU infrastructure. - Exceptional communication: able to run a sharp discovery call, present to a VP, and debug a latency issue with an ML engineer in the same afternoon. Preferred Qualifications - 10+ years in technical field or engineering roles. - Experience with inference serving frameworks (vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM) and tuning deployments for real workloads. - Experience operating as a technical authority inside a customer's environment building within their infrastructure, navigating their constraints, and shipping code that runs in their production systems. - Track record taking GenAI POCs from prototype to production-scale deployments. - Experience with hyperscaler AI platforms (Azure AI Foundry, AWS Bedrock/SageMaker, GCP Vertex). - Experience building or integrating agentic systems, tool-use chains, or AI-native developer toolchains. WHY FIREWORKS? - Solve Hard Problems: Tackle challenges at the forefront of AI infrastructure, from low-latency inference to scalable model serving. - Build What’s Next: Work with bleeding-edge technology that impacts how businesses and developers harness AI globally. - Ownership & Impact: Join a fast-growing, passionate team where your work directly shapes the future of AI—no bureaucracy, just results. - Learn from the Best: Collaborate with world-class engineers and AI researchers who thrive on curiosity and innovation. Fireworks AI is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all innovators.

jobs.description_text: Get to know the Team The OmniCommerce team is a close-knitted team with diverse backgrounds, sharing a common purpose - to build the best products to engage our customers online and offline. The team is bonded over the passion for building user-first products, driven by numbers and analytical thinking. The Analytics team’s mission is to use data and experimentation to drive product and business innovation. We focus on providing data-driven insights to deliver an impeccable and seamless experience for our consumers, merchants, and driver-partners. Get to know the role We are looking for a Data Scientist (Analytics) to join our OmniCommerce Analytics team and help turn data into decisions across deals, reservations, loyalty, and CRM — the products that drive offline footfall to our merchants. You will work closely with product managers, data scientists, engineers, and stakeholders to run experiments, surface insights, and build the dashboards and analyses that guide day-to-day product decisions. This is a high-ownership, high-learning role: you will be trusted to move fast, close your own knowledge gaps, and grow into an independent analytical partner for the team. The Day-to-Day Activities Product Analytics: Partner with the product, design, and engineering teams to derive insights, support experiment design, and inform key product decisions. Strategic & Business Analytics: Support strategic initiatives with data analytics and insights, including deep-dives into customer and merchant behaviour, product efficacy, and ad-hoc projects. Your role will be to: Run A/B tests and analyse experiment results, translating them into clear, actionable recommendations for product iterations. Support experiment design by helping to define hypotheses and success metrics alongside product managers and senior analysts. Conduct deep-dive analyses of user and merchant behaviour to uncover trends, patterns, and root causes. Build and maintain intuitive dashboards that give stakeholders real-time visibility into product and feature performance. Contribute to defining and tracking key business metrics, and proactively flag anomalies or opportunities. Process and distill stakeholder requirements into concise insights through reports, presentations, and dashboards.
